name: Majjige Huli
steps: Soak chana dal 30 minutes. Peel, deseed and cube ash gourd; cook in 200 ml water with turmeric and salt for 12–15 minutes until just tender.
Grind drained dal with coconut, chillies, ginger, cumin and remaining water to a smooth paste. Whisk yogurt separately until smooth.
Stir the paste into the cooked gourd and simmer 5 minutes. Turn heat very low, add yogurt and warm gently without boiling so it stays smooth.
Heat oil in a small pan; crackle mustard, asafoetida and curry leaves. Pour the hot tempering over the huli and serve with rice.
tips: Never boil the curry after adding yogurt.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
